# Follow-up 12 interpretation — AT02

Run `b98b78ee-9162-419e-ae2f-d1d9a618a3e8`, harness `65e18e67`.
**Blocked: 150 pass / 0 blocked checks / 0 failed checks.** F11-03 is blocked on
**no failed Apply observed** (zero failures in the complete producer stream),
not passed. The historical generation-13 failures and their old positive-control
expectation remain unchanged in [follow-up 11](history/follow-up-11/AT02.json).

The F11-02 prerequisite now requires all of the following before launching any
positive forwarding probe: latest accepted report for the current incarnation,
received within 15 seconds, forwarding enabled and no block reasons;
`desired = applied = observed = report's lease generation`; that exact lease
unexpired with nonempty signed member grants; intended device authorized with
current binding and live member grant in that lease; the binding present in the
node's local desired state at the same generation. The latest same-boot producer
heartbeat must serve at that generation with the same populated lease ID. Its
original producer run ID/sequence and the accepted report are retained. A newer
withdrawal cannot be bypassed by selecting an older serving heartbeat. Missing
readiness stops the positive probe; actual counted forwarding is asserted
separately. Both D-077 re-grant forwarding checks pass in this new run: generation 10
and generation 21, each with one populated member grant, joined to producer
run `3065df99-331a-47ba-b867-cf29550a5ea6` sequences 219 and 602 respectively.
[Exact readiness rows](F12-F11-02-readiness.json).

D-135 requires revoked-source drop and an admitted-sibling outage bracket from
baseline command start/end to the **next successful Apply** end, with all lost
packets counted and forwarding returning at that recovery. No old generation is
restored and no outage ceiling is inferred from the 100 ms install budget.
The revoked UDP/9 source drops and the sibling UDP/9 control forwards. The
independent 20 ms UDP/40002 stream retains **3,976 attempts / 3,976 ingresses /
3,955 egresses / 21 losses**, zero send/read errors and zero capture socket drops.
Thirteen missing egresses have ingress timestamps inside completed guards;
eight are outside. These are userspace packet-observation versus command-time
correlations, not exact kernel verdict times or established drop causes. No
failed Apply occurred, so there is no baseline-to-recovery bracket to qualify.
The losses are not erased by that absence. [All packets and Apply host records](F12-AT02-recovery.json),
[complete original producer stream](AT02-enforcement-timing.json).

Apply diagnostics retain `host.before_apply`, `host.after_apply`, sanitized
command kind and optional exit/signal joined by original run/sequence. Only a
failed install over its recorded bound plus valid ordered host samples with
zero idle delta and >1 runnable at both endpoints can receive “fail-closed install
overrun with recorded host contention.” **cause_status remains unproven**;
no label changes acceptance. Missing verification differs from failed verification;
a subsequent member-path withdrawal is not retroactively a failed install.

D-134: [D−101 ms,D] is the conservative expiry window; every pre-D and renewal
loss remains recorded, with no fixed outer-guard ceiling. The finite-expiry
reader has 193/193 successful samples; last TCP/UDP reply increment is observed
85.203130 ms before D. Across both withdrawals, all 221 samples retain their
counter/status diagnostics and producer joins. Observed reply increments bound
samples; they do not identify the exact packet cutoff or waive early loss.

**F12-01, separate observation:** all eight losses outside completed guards fall
in the command bracket beginning with successful `policy_missing` baseline 362
and ending with successful generation-13 Apply 366 (producer run `3065df99`).
The baseline-start → Apply-end bracket is **236.970251 ms** and contains nine
